ma.onNetworkStatusChange(function callback)

Listen for network status change events.

Parameter

function callback

Callback function for listening for network status change events.

Parameter

Object res
Attribute Type Description
isConnected Boolean Whether a network connection is available.
networkType String Network type.

Sample Code

ma.onNetworkStatusChange(function (res) {
  console.log(res.isConnected);
  console.log(res.networkType);
});
